attributes.title: SOC 2 CC8 — Change Management | Compliance Dashboard
attributes.visState:
{"title": "SOC 2 CC8 — Change Management | Compliance Dashboard", "type": "markdown", "aggs": [], "params": {"fontSize": 12, "openLinksInNewTab": true, "markdown": "## SOC 2 — CC8: Change Management

**Trust Services Criterion:** The entity authorizes, designs, develops, configures, documents, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures to meet its objectives.

| Sub-Criterion | Audit Focus | Wazuh Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **CC8.1** | Changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures are authorized, documented, tested, and approved | File integrity monitoring events, change classification, unauthorized modification detection |

**Data Source:** Wazuh File Integrity Monitoring (FIM / Syscheck) — detects file additions, modifications, and deletions on monitored endpoints.  
**Default Evidence Period:** Last 90 days (SOC 2 Type 2 examination window)"}}
